purpose: Verify strategic research proposal escalates to Director regardless of budget
preconditions: Proposal is marked is_strategic=True with budget 50,000
expected_result: Returns True for strategic proposal

purpose: Verify Director approval required for proposal budget >= 10 Lakhs threshold
expected_result: Returns True indicating Director approval required

purpose: Verify Director approval not required for proposal budget < 10 Lakhs threshold
expected_result: Returns False allowing Dean approval

purpose: Verify Director authorization required for high-value expenditure >= 2 Lakhs
expected_result: Returns True indicating Director authorization required

purpose: Verify Director authorization not required for expenditure < 2 Lakhs
expected_result: Returns False

purpose: Verify research proposal approval route sequence statuses
expected_result: Route contains Faculty, HoD, Admin, Dean, and Director states

purpose: Verify mandatory research proposal fields validation passes with all fields present
expected_result: Empty errors list

purpose: Verify proposal validation rejects missing title, pi_id, dept, agency, or objectives
expected_result: Returns validation error for each missing field

purpose: Verify proposal validation enforces strictly positive timeline duration (timeline_months > 0)
preconditions: Proposal with timeline_months=0 or negative duration
expected_result: Errors list must flag non-positive timeline duration per BR-RSPC-014

purpose: Verify review decisions capture automatic timestamp
expected_result: timestamp field has auto_now_add=True and db_index=True

purpose: Verify review decisions capture optional or required reviewer remarks
expected_result: remarks text is properly stored

purpose: Verify consultancy approval routing statuses follow institutional policy
expected_result: Status constants are defined and active

purpose: Verify consultancy validation enforces minimum 20% institutional share
preconditions: Consultancy with institutional share below 20% of total cost
expected_result: Validation must reject insufficient institutional share per BR-RSPC-022

purpose: Verify high-value consultancy (>= 10 Lakhs) escalates to Director
expected_result: Returns True requiring Director approval for high-value consultancy

purpose: Verify staff appointment routing through Dean and Director permissions
action_or_input: Check staff management permissions in registry
expected_result: rspc.staff.manage is assigned to admin and dean

purpose: Verify Dean financial approval is strictly bounded by delegation limit (2 Lakhs)
expected_result: Limit equals Decimal('200000.00')

purpose: Verify financial request >= 2 Lakhs escalates to Director
expected_result: Returns True indicating Director escalation

purpose: Verify financial request lifecycle events are audited
action_or_input: Instantiate RSPCAuditTrail for financial request verification
expected_result: Audit entry captures entity_type financial and action

purpose: Verify procurement within budget passes validation
expected_result: Empty errors list

purpose: Verify procurement exceeding budget fails validation
expected_result: Returns error indicating budget exceeded

purpose: Verify procurement approval permissions in Dean role grants
expected_result: Permission is present

purpose: Verify progress reporting model tracks period start and end dates
action_or_input: Inspect ProgressReport period_start and period_end fields
expected_result: Fields exist as DateFields

purpose: Verify authorized access to historical progress reports
action_or_input: Check report submission permission and ordering
expected_result: Ordering is by -created_at and faculty has report.submit

purpose: Verify progress report captures funds utilized for compliance
expected_result: funds_utilized is DecimalField with max_digits=14

purpose: Verify project closure rejects archival when financial settlement is pending
expected_result: Rejection error returned

purpose: Verify RSPC module does not declare undeclared external foreign keys (ADR-0013)
action_or_input: Inspect foreign keys on all RSPC models
expected_result: No cross-module ForeignKey fields exist on any RSPC model

purpose: Verify role-based access control maps all operations to permissions
expected_result: Contains 22 distinct operation mappings

purpose: Verify faculty cannot approve proposals or financial requests
action_or_input: Check if approval permissions exist in faculty ROLE_GRANTS
expected_result: Neither proposal.approve_dean nor financial.approve_dean is in faculty grants

purpose: Verify structured audit trail table exists and stores required fields
expected_result: db_table is rspc_audit_trail

purpose: Verify staff model does not perform payroll execution
action_or_input: Check for absence of salary payment fields
expected_result: No salary disbursement execution fields present

purpose: Verify financial request does not process banking transactions
action_or_input: Check for absence of payment transaction IDs
expected_result: No bank execution fields present

purpose: Verify procurement request does not manage physical warehouse bins
action_or_input: Check for absence of warehouse bin fields
expected_result: No physical warehouse execution fields present

purpose: Verify project updates are restricted to valid active lifecycle states
action_or_input: Check domain rules for can_update_project guard
expected_result: Domain rules must provide can_update_project guard enforcing lifecycle update constraints
